title: The Bed Turned Down
youtube_title: The Bed Turned Down | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude shows up in what you do next.
summary: At a workshop with tools on a low peg, Violeta notices that Papa has already taken care of a bed turned down when you were still drying your hair. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Violeta does one useful thing Papa did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
